_doc: Rival Houses in the flesh (src/systems/rivalHouses.js): each rival House's head, purse, family and retinue on the map. Each errand (trade, court, shadow the player, invest in land, home) is scored by what it is worth now: weights × the best bargain's gain / think.tradeNorm (capped), the best estate's yield / invest.minYield, standing at court / standing.favourite; trait weights add; the ambition's errand is multiplied by think.ambition. Money is gold; days are game days.
_invest: Land: a rival buys listed estates (systems/landMarket.js) within range it can pay for keeping reserve gold, spending at most maxShare of the purse, yielding at least minYield a year; rents reach the purse weekly. Below sellBelow gold it lists its cheapest estate at sellAt of value.
_standing: Court favour per realm: fades by decay every decayDays; at favourite or more the crown pays standing × pension gold a week from its treasury, and the rival's whispers there cut whisper + standing/whisperPer reputation. Renown adds renown/renownPer favour per visit.
_guard: After the player falls on a retinue it hires up to step guards at cost each (max in all), each adding per strength and wage gold a week. A House at waylay.feud or more that is too weak to waylay you hires one a week (keeping invest.reserve + 3 × cost) when enough guards could match waylay.edge × your army. Once forgetDays pass without an attack or a hiring, one is let go each week.
_waylay: A rival at feud >= feud, with no hunt in `every` days, within `range` hexes, and whose retinue is at least edge × your army's strength may ride out to waylay you: its retinue turns hostile (WorldUnit.isHostile) and the road-encounter choices apply. It hunts for `days` days. Robbed you (or beat your army): feud robFeud. Beaten off: feud +beatenFeud and it keeps beatenGuards of its guards; you take attack.lootShare of its purse with no reputation or karma lost.
_ties: The rival Houses' regard for each other (-100..100, both ways), starting in `start`. Ousting another as a court's favourite: oust. Each week, Houses whose realms are at war change by `war`, allied realms by `allied`, and two Houses both at feud >= commonFoeFeud with you by `commonFoe` (a shared enemy). Each year it fades `drift` toward 0, and two Houses at matchMin or more wed grown children with chance matchChance (+match). At allyAt or more they are allies: feud you earn with one adds spill × as much with the other; at enemyAt or less, it eases the other's feud by spill/2 × as much.
_ambitions: Each head pursues one ambition (weighted by traits' ambitions; revenge only at feud >= revenge.feud). Fulfilled → +renown and a new one; abandoned after giveUpDays. wealth: purse + land value reaches max(min, now + min(now × (grow − 1), maxMore)); land: holds `more` estates more; favour: a court's favourite; revenge: pays for `plots` more plots.
